messages:
sarah_cs: Caught a late intake from HighTide during onboarding. They want DPA answers, a short KMS/key-provenance excerpt (redacted), SOC2 scope confirmation, and clarification on embeddings retention/pseudonymization. Deadline = next Wednesday EOD.
evidence-bot: uploaded file hightide_vendor_questionnaire_v1.pdf (shared)
ellie_pm: thanks. renewal check is in three weeks; CS please prioritize so sales has breathing room.
sarah_cs: ask list: 1) confirm encryption and whether BYOK is available for Hosted 2) provide an example of key provenance with identifiers masked 3) state rotation cadence and where logs are retained 4) default embeddings retention and options for pseudonymization.
matt_security: I can draft the attestation. Quick thought — keep Hosted wording non-binding (no ARNs) and offer evidence under an evidence request/NDA.
owen_infra: BYOK note: Hosted does not support customer-supplied keys out-of-the-box; Dedicated/Private do. If they ask to bring keys for Hosted, that’s a project -> need infra+security review and timeline (est ~3 weeks).
matt_security: attestation draft below (short): "Redwood Inference encrypts customer data at rest using industry-standard, HSM-backed key management. For Hosted deployments keys are managed by Redwood; Dedicated and Private deployments support customer-supplied keys with integration guidance. Key rotations occur every 12 months or immediately after suspected compromise. Key usage and rotation events are logged to our centralized audit system and retained according to our retention policy. Redacted key-provenance samples can be provided to customers under an evidence request."
sarah_cs: good. Owen, can you paste a redacted provenance example we can attach (no real ARNs)?
owen_infra: redacted example (masking IDs):
```
Alias: redwood-hightide-2025
KMS Identifier: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:XXXXXXXXXXXX:key/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx (redacted)
Created: 2024-07-18
LastRotation: 2025-07-18
RotationPolicy: 12 months
```
matt_security: add line about audit access: "Audit logs are retained in our centralized store and we can provide redacted excerpts under an evidence request subject to security review." keep it explicit.
sarah_cs: embeddings: HighTide wants to understand retention and pseudonymization options; default policy here is 45 days for transient vector storage unless customer requests otherwise. We can also offer a pre-ingest salted-hash pseudonymization workflow but note it may reduce matching fidelity.
ellie_pm: perfect. Also capture: if they request audit log snippets or BYOK for Hosted that will be a sales-impacting ask. Sales should plan for time/cost. I'll notify sales separately.
sarah_cs: uploading answers + attestation + redacted provenance + a one-pager explaining pseudonymization tradeoffs.
evidence-bot: uploaded files: hightide_answers_v1.txt, hightide_kms_attestation.txt, hightide_key_provenance_redacted.txt, hightide_embeddings_privacy_onepager.pdf
sarah_cs: posting answers to HighTide now. Please ping in thread if they ask for evidence so we can route to infra/legal. I'll log any feedback in the onboarding tracker. Thanks all :thumbsup:
